THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
081
Behind the image
41 / Claret Pinstripe
REFERENCE 5803.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 032
Art direction: Preppy schoolgirl romance, claret and cream palette, soft studio light, clean
full-length framing.
Full-length vertical fashion lookbook photograph of an original adult woman with long wavy
brown hair, blunt bangs and a small pearl hair clip, standing straight and facing the camera with a
soft neutral expression. She wears a cream long-sleeve blouse with a black ribbon bow under a
claret pinstripe pinafore mini dress with ruffled straps, a sweetheart waist and a pleated skirt,
white ribbed knee socks and black satin ballet flats. Warm greige seamless backdrop, soft studio
light, claret and cream palette, no text or logos.
42 / Sage Qipao
REFERENCE 5802.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 033
Art direction: Modern Chinese-inspired streetwear, soft sage tonal fabric, edgy black boots, pale
lilac-gray backdrop.
Photorealistic vertical fashion editorial of an original adult East Asian woman with wavy black hair
and blunt bangs, strong pink blush, a deep red lip and long silver tassel earrings, posing with a
cool direct gaze. She wears a sage-green jacquard mini qipao-style dress with a mandarin collar,
silver knot buttons, puff sleeves, a ruched bust and a layered tulle skirt, with black knee-high
boots. Pale lilac-gray backdrop, soft light, modern Chinese-inspired streetwear, no text or logos.
